digest.component_or_area: LLM verifier model-class resolution across verifier paths
propositions: Three separate verifier-selection code paths break the default-provider downgrade because their equality tests treat any non-default (e.g. Bedrock or provider-qualified) model as an explicit operator override.
The fix introduces a single resolve_model_string function in model_classes.py that resolves the reserved class names trivial/standard/frontier and returns any other string unchanged.
All verifier call sites (resolve_verifier_model, _verifier_cfg, completion's equality test, and code-review.yaml's verify step) must resolve the standard class regardless of cfg.model.
code-review.yaml Pass-2 must resolve the standard class rather than the frontier model to preserve greedy verification determinism.
resolve_class emits a provider-qualified id, breaking the promised byte-identical output when no class is configured (bare vs anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6).
A test must exercise _verifier_cfg through its real callers at xcheck.py:198 and xcheck.py:336 to prevent a caller passing plain cfg from silently leaving Pass-2/Pass-4 on the frontier model.
